newsitem.title: USA: Unionamerica names Spass non-exec chairman.
newsitem.headline: Unionamerica names Spass non-exec chairman.

text.p: Unionamerica Holdings Plc said Monday its chairman Philip Marcell would retire July 1 and Robert Spass would be appointed non-executive chairman of the company.

Spass was part of the investor group which led the management buyout of Unionamerica in 1993. He is president and chief executive officer of International Insurance Advisors Inc, which was one of four groups that led the management buyout and was also the advisor to the other groups, a spokesman said.
The company went public in December 1995.

Unionamerica said it had recognized the possibility of Philip Marcell retiring sometime after reaching the age of 60 and had already ensured the necessary continuity by appointing with effect from January 1, 1997 Ian Sinclair as chief executive of Unionamerica Insurance Co Ltd and Peter Cooper as managing director - finance and administration.
